name: 格奥尔格
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:258
who: Georg Sten, a human quarryman turned wall-mender, sixty-two and looks it: about 181 cm, tall with a back stooped from forty years of carrying white stone, broad shoulders, very wide rough hands with knuckles thick as pebbles and a blackened thumbnail on the right hand. Short-cropped white hair and white eyebrows, pale ice-blue eyes that narrow when he looks at a wall. Weathered, deeply lined face. Stubborn, sparing with words, solid as a wall.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old man's face, deep lines at the eyes and mouth, weathered pink-red cheeks from wind, short white eyebrows, narrowed ice-blue eyes, a firm closed mouth, a strong square jaw; clearly an old man and not a young one.
build: 181 cm, tall and heavy-framed: very wide shoulders, a back bent forward from carrying stone, thick forearms.
palette: white-stone grey and chalk white, ice blue, worn leather brown, rusty iron
casual: His wall-mender's clothes: a thick leather quarryman's apron whose front is streaked white with stone dust over a rough undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled and heavy trousers; a stout hardwood longbow slung on his back, a quiver of arrows at his hip, a stone chisel stuck in the apron pocket. He stands with a slight stoop, one hand resting on a block of white stone, a stubborn, steady look.
private: Resting in the yard behind the wall: the apron off, a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt open at the collar, old wool trousers and worn boots, a fleece vest. He sits on an upturned bucket turning a shard of white stone in his thick fingers, a quiet, faraway look.
battle: Holding the breach: the dust-whitened leather apron belted tight over a patched hide jerkin with a thin enchanted iron plate nailed on, a rune-cut iron tag at the chest, leather bracers, the quiver at his hip. He draws the hardwood longbow with his thumb pressed on the arrow nock like gripping a chisel, the arrowhead etched with a tiny rune that glows. Feet planted wide, a hard narrowed look.
formal: On the day the names are read: the long garrison coat of undyed wool brushed free of dust and patched at the cuffs, the collar folded down, a small iron tag chiselled with the Dawnridge sunrise rays nailed to the chest, a cord tied round his left wrist, the chisel carried in the belt. A ward stitched in thread at the hem glows faintly. He stands upright as far as his stoop allows, hands folded, a grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the narrowed ice-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer with a heavy, patient look, a stubborn closed mouth. Cold grey dawn light from the side on a white-stone wall behind. Foreground blur: white stone dust drifting and a blurred chisel. He wears the dust-streaked leather apron.

name: 莱娜特
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:314
who: Lenate Sten, a human girl archer of the wall, sixteen years old and looks it: about 163 cm, slim, long in the arms and legs and still growing, wholly covered by her clothes. Wheat-coloured hair in two short braids to keep the bowstring clear, pale ice-blue eyes with one narrowed when she aims, a thick callus on the right thumb. A blunt, quick, earnest air; she talks about her grandfather without stopping and goes quiet at the mention of the breach.
palette: wheat gold and ice blue, worn leather brown, white-stone grey, faded green
casual: Her wall clothes: a resized leather jerkin that was her father's when he was young, over a long-sleeved wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, trousers and boots; a light shortbow on her back, a quiver of arrows she whittled herself, slightly crooked, at her side. She stands with her thumb pressed on the string hand, an earnest, eager look.
private: At home in the wall-side yard: a long-sleeved, high-necked undyed wool dress to the shins with a knitted vest, wool stockings and soft boots, the braids loose over the shoulders. She sits on the steps whittling an arrow, a quiet, intent look.
battle: Handing arrows on the stairs: the resized leather jerkin laced to the collar with a thin enchanted iron plate sewn across the chest, ward thread along its edge, leather bracers, a long bundle of arrows in the crook of one arm, a quiver at her side, the light shortbow on her back. She braces with the feet apart, holding one arrow out toward the viewer, its head etched with a tiny glowing rune. A fierce, steady look, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the stair-post outfit: braced and steady, the feet apart, the chin up, holding one arrow out toward the viewer with the thumb pressed on its nock, the other arm full of arrows; she is not smiling in this one.
formal: On the day the names are read: her father's old undyed wool garrison coat resized, the sleeves rolled twice and worn white at the cuffs, over a plain long-sleeved wool dress with a laced collar, a small iron tag chiselled with the Dawnridge sunrise rays on the chest, a cord tied round her left wrist, a few of her crooked arrows in the quiver, the braids neatly pinned. She stands straight with her hands folded, a solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the eyes open and looking straight at the viewer, an earnest, serious look, the mouth closed. Cold dawn light from one side on a white-stone wall. Foreground blur: a crooked arrow held near the viewer. She wears the leather jerkin.

name: 加兹
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:370
who: Gaz, a shadow-demon of the southern enemy camps, a hundred and thirty-five years old but looking only thirty-something with a few fine lines at the eyes: about 172 cm, lean, with long hands and feet, who makes no sound when he walks. A pair of thin short horns curving backward, a tiny dusky-purple flame no bigger than a candle-wick on the tip of each. Ash-grey skin, dusky-purple slit pupils that glow in shadow. A long leather case on his back holding a pair of deep-red slender horns. When he stands still, his shadow keeps moving half a step behind him. A quick, careful, half-a-step-apart air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean sharp face of a man in his thirties, a few fine lines at the corners of the eyes, ash-grey skin, dusky-purple slit pupils, thin eyebrows, a closed mouth; horns thin and short, swept back, with a tiny purple flame on each tip.
build: 172 cm, lean and long-limbed: narrow shoulders, light and silent on his feet.
palette: ash grey and soot black, dusky violet, bone white, dull deep red
casual: His everyday clothes: a close-stitched short jerkin of grey-black leather with tight cuffs and hem, hung with nothing that could rattle, dark trousers and soft-soled boots; a long leather case slung on his back holding the pair of red horns; at his belt two short knives, one of them a plain bone knife. He stands half-turned, a quiet, watchful look.
private: Off duty in the camp: the leather jerkin off, a long-sleeved dark linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, soft trousers and quiet boots, the long case on its strap laid on his knees. He sits unlacing the case and looking inside at the horns, a still, private look.
battle: Slipping into the enemy line along a shadow: the close grey-black jerkin, a dark hood pulled up, a short knife in each hand held low and reversed, the bone knife at the belt, the case on his back. Crouched on the balls of his feet at a wall's foot, a sharp, silent look.
formal: At the naming of the children in daylight: his close-stitched grey-black leather jerkin brushed clean with a dark grey wool overcoat worn open over it, the cuffs and hem quiet, a thin dusk-violet thread running through the collar. The short horns are bare and the leather case is on his back. A small child's blanket is folded over one arm. He stands straight in plain sunlight, a calm, grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly aside, the dusky-purple slit pupils glowing a little, looking straight at the viewer, a quiet, wary look. Low warm daylight from one side and a long soft shadow behind him that lags half a step. Foreground blur: dark wall stone and a tiny purple flame from a horn tip. He wears the grey-black leather jerkin.

name: 弗里多林·斯滕
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:518
who: Fridolin Sten, a human stone-carver's son from the east, seventeen years old and looks it: about 171 cm, sturdy in the shoulders and back from hauling stone, wholly covered by his clothes. Messy flaxen hair with white stone dust always caught in the ends, pale green eyes that lean close to read inscriptions and squint at distance, a thin pale scar across the bridge of the nose from a stone chip. Thick-knuckled hands with white lime under the nails. A patient, careful, self-deprecating air.
palette: flax and stone-dust white, pale green, canvas beige, worn tool steel
casual: His stone-carver's clothes: a thick canvas smock with the front rubbed white, over a wool shirt with rolled sleeves, trousers and boots; at his belt a leather roll holding seven chisels of different sizes and a wooden mallet, a borrowed soldier's bow on his back. He stands with one hand on the roll, a shy, earnest look.
private: Evening in the yard: a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, a knitted vest, wool trousers and soft boots. He sits turning a half-carved name stone in his hands, a quiet, intent look.
battle: Crouched in the collapsed pit: the canvas smock belted tight over a leather jerkin, bracers, the chisel roll at his belt, the borrowed bow gripped in both hands with an arrow nocked and not drawn. Eyes narrowed at the dark ahead, a nervous but steady look.
formal: On the day the names are read: a plain canvas wall-smock rubbed white with stone dust and brushed, over a wool shirt with rolled sleeves and a short belted undyed wool coat, a small iron tag chiselled with the Dawnridge sunrise rays on the chest, a cord tied round his left wrist, a leather chisel roll at his belt, hair combed flat. He carries a finished name stone in both arms, its cut marks glinting. A solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the eyes open and looking straight at the viewer, an earnest, serious look, the mouth closed. Cold dawn light from one side, white stone dust drifting. Foreground blur: a chisel and a stone block with half-cut letters. He wears the dusty canvas smock.

name: 因格博格·斯滕
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:574
who: Ingeborg Sten, a human wall-mender, seventy-four years old and looks it: about 169 cm, tall and big-boned, the back still straight, the right shoulder lower than the left (on the viewer's left when they face us, a shoulder crushed by a falling stone). White hair braided in one thick plait and pinned up at the back of the head, pale ice-blue eyes that narrow when she looks at a wall, cheeks wind-reddened, a thick yellowed callus on the right thumb. Hard, sharp-tongued, recording every name in the family in her head.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old woman's face, deep lines at the eyes and either side of the mouth, wind-reddened cheeks, white eyebrows, narrowed ice-blue eyes, a firm thin mouth; clearly a woman in her seventies.
build: 169 cm, tall and big-boned, the back straight, a broad ribcage and strong forearms, the right shoulder lower than the left, the build of an old woman with a modest bust and a sturdy waist.
palette: white and ice blue, weathered leather brown, wall-stone grey, rusty iron
casual: Her wall-house clothes: an old Sten-family leather jerkin whose right shoulder has been re-stitched, over a long-sleeved wool dress to the shins, a quiver and a stone chisel at the belt, the family's hardwood longbow slung on her back. She stands upright, one hand on the bow, a hard, steady look.
private: In the yard at night: a long dark wool dress with a knitted shawl, the jerkin off, soft boots, the white braid unpinned over one shoulder. She sits polishing the old bow on her knees, a tired, stern look.
battle: At the breach: the re-stitched leather jerkin laced up with an enchanted iron plate strapped over the lower right shoulder, leather bracers, a quiver at her side. She draws the hardwood Sten longbow, tiny bone tally beads swinging from its limb, her thumb pressed on the nock, the lower shoulder braced, a faint rune glowing on the bowstring. A fierce narrowed look.
formal: On the day the names are read: the old Sten-family leather jerkin with its re-stitched right shoulder worn over a long wool dress, an undyed garrison coat draped over her shoulders, a small iron tag chiselled with the Dawnridge sunrise rays on the chest, a cord tied round the left wrist, the white braid pinned up. Tiny bone tally beads hang along the hardwood bow. She stands straight with her hands folded on the bow stock, a grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the narrowed ice-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer with a hard, tired look, the mouth firm. Cold grey dawn light from one side on a white-stone wall. Foreground blur: a worn chisel and drifting stone dust. She wears the leather jerkin with the re-stitched shoulder.

name: 格尔贝特
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:708
who: Gerbert Wagen, a human wall veteran and instructor at the war academy, sixty years old and looks it: about 181 cm, lean and tall with a slight stoop, the left shoulder lower than the right (on the viewer's right when they face us). Short-cropped grey-white hair, a clean-shaven face, olive-green eyes that narrow as if measuring a distance, scarred hands with stone dust under the nails. A pedantic, exacting air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean old soldier's face, lines at the eyes and mouth, grey-white short hair, clean-shaven, olive-green narrowed eyes that look as if measuring a distance, a firm mouth.
build: 181 cm, lean and tall with a slight stoop and a lower left shoulder; long, spare arms.
palette: grey-white and olive green, worn garrison grey, stone white, brass
casual: His instructor's clothes: a long garrison coat worn white at the seams with the cuffs patched, over a plain wool shirt and trousers; a short sword at his belt, a palm-sized slate and a short engraving chisel carried in the coat pocket. He holds a small brass lamp with a glass chimney and a steady white flame that needs no oil. He stands with a slight stoop, a patient, measuring look.
private: In his room of engraved slates: the coat off, a long-sleeved wool shirt and an old knitted vest, worn trousers and slippers. He sits scratching a line onto a slate, the brass lamp beside him, a quiet, absorbed look.
battle: On the wall at the south tower: the white-worn garrison coat belted tight over a leather jerkin, a short sword drawn and held low, the brass lamp held up in the other hand. Feet planted on the stones, a steady, measuring look.
formal: On the first day of the academy: the instructor's garrison coat worn white at the seams and patched at the cuffs, brushed clean, a grey academy sash over it, a small iron tag chiselled with the Dawnridge sunrise rays on the chest, a cord tied round his left wrist, a slate and an engraving chisel in the pocket. The brass lamp hung high behind him gives a steady miracle light. He stands very upright with one hand on the slate, a grave, teacherly look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the olive-green eyes narrowed as if measuring the viewer, a patient look. Soft white lamp-light from below on one side, cool grey dawn on the other. Foreground blur: a slate with chiselled lines and the brass lamp. He wears the white-worn garrison coat.

name: 康斯坦策
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:764
who: Konstanze Reiherbruck, a human lake-bridge guard's daughter and one of the first students of the war academy, seventeen years old and looks it: about 172 cm, tall with wide shoulders and long legs, wholly covered by her clothes. Deep-gold hair in one thick braid coiled at the back of the head, grey-blue eyes like winter lake water, a thin pale scar on the chin. She stands with the feet far apart as if the ground might sway. A stubborn, competitive, earnest air; she hates losing and stamps her foot when she does.
palette: deep gold and lake grey-blue, issued leather brown, bridge-stone grey, a little heron white
casual: Her academy clothes: an issued leather jerkin a size too big with the sleeves rolled, over a wool shirt, trousers and boots; on her left arm a round shield with a bridge emblem on its face, the rim chipped at one corner, a short sword at her belt. She stands with the feet wide apart, a stubborn, eager look.
private: Evening in the academy yard: a long-sleeved, high-necked undyed wool dress to the shins with a knitted shawl, wool stockings and soft boots, the braid loose over one shoulder. She sits on a step cleaning her father's round shield on her knees, a quiet, stubborn look.
battle: In the shield line: the oversized leather jerkin laced to the collar with a first thin enchanted iron plate strapped over the chest, ward lines stitched along its edge, leather bracers. The chipped round shield with the bridge emblem is held high on the left arm and the short sword is drawn in the right, feet planted wide. A fierce, determined look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the academy's opening day: a lake-grey wool coat worn open at the throat with a folded collar, over a plain long-sleeved dress laced at the neck, a small iron badge with a bridge emblem, an issued leather vambrace polished, the braid neatly coiled. A ward thread is stitched around the cuffs. She holds the chipped round shield at her side, a serious look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the grey-blue eyes open and looking straight at the viewer, an earnest, determined look, the mouth closed. Cool lake-blue light from one side. Foreground blur: the chipped rim of a round shield. She wears the oversized leather jerkin.

name: 康斯坦策·接盾者
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:1757
who: Konstanze Reiherbruck, a human shield captain of the southern wall, a legend who has looked sixty ever since the day the shield-bearer fell: about 172 cm, tall with wide shoulders and long legs, the feet planted wide when she stands. Deep-gold hair gone white, in one thick braid coiled at the back of the head and never cut, grey-blue eyes like winter lake water, a thin pale scar on the chin, thick calluses along the forearm that holds the shield. A long shield on one arm and her father's chipped round shield on her back. A firm, steady, foot-stamping-when-beaten air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a woman of sixty, lines at the eyes and mouth, white eyebrows, grey-blue eyes, a thin pale scar on the chin, a firm mouth; clearly a mature woman and not a young one.
build: 172 cm, tall, wide-shouldered and long-legged, strongly built with a soldier's solid frame, a modest bust and a sturdy waist.
palette: white-gold and lake grey-blue, shield-steel grey, worn leather brown, bridge-stone grey
casual: Her wall clothes: a battered shield-bearer's leather jerkin with a lake-star crest nailed on the chest over a long-sleeved wool dress, a cord tied round her left wrist; a long shield held on the left arm, her father's round shield with a bridge emblem and a chipped rim on her back. She stands with the feet wide apart, a firm, steady look. Both shields are visible in this panel: the tall long shield, reaching from her shoulder down to her knee, is strapped on her left forearm (on the viewer's right when she faces us) and held upright at her side, while the small round shield with the bridge emblem hangs on her back behind the other shoulder; do not leave out the long shield.
private: Off duty in the barracks: a long-sleeved undyed wool dress to the shins and a knitted shawl, the jerkin off, soft boots, the white braid over one shoulder. She sits on a bench rubbing the old round shield on her knees, a tired, kind look.
battle: Leading the reformed shield line: lake-grey enchanted plate over the leather jerkin, etched with star-line runes that glow pale, leather bracers. A long shield is braced in front with its edge on the ground, a short sword in the right hand, the round bridge shield on her back. A few motes of starlight drift off the plate. Feet planted wide, a hard, steady look.
formal: At the shield stele: a long lake-grey garrison coat over her dress, its hem weighted with stitched wire wards, the lake-star crest pinned to the chest glowing softly, the cord on the left wrist, the white braid coiled, a few motes of pale starlight drifting at the crest. She stands straight with the long shield grounded at her side, a pale ward line along its edge, a grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the grey-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer with a steady, weathered look, the face unchanged by years but the eyes carrying them. Cool lake-blue light from one side. Foreground blur: the chipped rim of the old round shield. She wears the shield-bearer's jerkin.

name: 多布森
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:818
who: Dobson Reins-Bell, a halfling cart-driver's youngest son from the Honey-mead Hills and a student of the war academy, nineteen years old: about 114 cm, short and round with a youthful, soft halfling face, large bare feet and short nimble hands. Tightly curled orange-red hair, a round face with a red nose, quick violet eyes that dart as he counts. A fast, interrupting, number-counting air; he beats everyone at sums and no one at fighting.
palette: orange-red and violet, ink-stained cream, faded academy grey, rope brown
casual: His academy clothes: an academy coat far too long for him with the hem rolled up three times over a wool shirt and short trousers, bare feet in summer; hanging at his belt a string of thin cord tied in counting knots, a small round shield on his arm, a slate on his back. He stands counting on his fingers, a quick, bright look.
private: Evening in the carters' yard: a long-sleeved wool shirt, a knitted vest, short trousers and bare feet, the counting cord looped round his neck. He sits on a grain sack tying a new knot, a cheerful, absorbed look.
battle: In the shield line, uneasy: the long coat belted tight, a little leather cap, the small round shield held up unsteadily on his left arm and a short club in his right, the slate on his back. Braced with big feet planted, a nervous but stubborn look.
formal: At the academy's opening day: a clean oversized academy coat buttoned up, the counting cord worn as a sash, a slate held under one arm, hair slicked down. He stands as tall as he can, a proud, bright look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the violet eyes looking straight at the viewer with a quick, bright, counting look, a wide grin. Warm lamp light from one side, cool dawn on the other. Foreground blur: knotted cord and a slate with figures chalked on it. He wears the oversized academy coat.

name: 伊兹拉
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:874
who: Izra, a young demon-kin woodworker's daughter from a small eastern town and the only horned student among the first academy students, sixteen years old and looks it: small and slim, about 158 cm, wholly covered by her clothes, long fingers. A pair of small, blunt horns swept back from the forehead, the colour of unpainted wood, with no flame on them. Black hair cut just below the ears so the horns show, dark-gold eyes that watch a distant fire for a long time, little pale splinter scars on the hands. A watchful, quiet air; she says little and what she says is looked at first.
palette: unpainted-wood buff and dark gold, black, faded academy grey, iron-ring silver
casual: Her academy clothes: an old jacket her mother resized, the cuffs worn shiny, over a wool shirt, a long skirt over trousers and boots; at the belt a narrow-bladed sword in a plain wooden scabbard (her father's work), the blade's spine engraved with a ring pattern; an iron shovel carried on one shoulder. She stands with her eyes on something far away, a watchful, quiet look.
private: Early evening in the lodging: a long-sleeved, high-necked undyed wool dress to the shins and a knitted shawl, soft shoes, the horns bare. She sits on a bench sanding a wooden scabbard on her knees, a quiet, absorbed look.
battle: Watching from behind the parapet: the resized jacket laced to the collar, leather bracers, a hood back, the narrow sword drawn and held low, its ring pattern showing along the spine. Crouched behind the stone, eyes on a far fire, a still, sharp look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the academy's opening day: the academy jacket her mother resized, brushed clean, the cuffs polished, over a long skirt and a wool shirt with a laced collar, a narrow grey sash, a small ring-pattern pin on the chest, the hair tucked behind the ears so the small blunt horns show. She holds the wooden scabbard in both hands, its ring pattern faintly glowing. She stands straight, a serious look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the dark-gold eyes open and looking straight at the viewer, a calm, serious look, the mouth closed. Warm firelight from far behind on one side, cool dawn on the other. Foreground blur: a wooden sword scabbard. She wears the resized jacket.

name: 克拉拉
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:1019
who: Clara, a human priestess of the Shield-bearer's southern shrine, forty years old and looks it: about 175 cm, tall and big-boned with wide shoulders like her father, easy to spot behind a shield line. Deep teal hair cut to just below the ears (the shrine's rule is no hair past the shoulder), wine-red eyes that look straight ahead and never up at the sky, a pale ring-shaped mark on the left palm worn by twenty-five years of prayer. A stubborn, questioning air; she believes and keeps asking.
face: FACE, as in the references: a woman of forty, faint lines at the eyes, a strong jaw, wine-red eyes looking straight ahead, deep teal hair at the jaw line, a firm mouth.
build: 175 cm, tall and big-boned, with broad shoulders and a strong, solid frame: a full bust, a firm waist and wide hips, the figure of a woman built to stand behind a shield line.
palette: deep teal and wine red, shrine iron-grey, shield steel, pale prayer-skin white
casual: Her shrine clothes: an iron-grey priestess's robe cut short to the knee so as to follow the shield line, over trousers and boots; a small round shield carved with the prayer on her back; at her belt a leather waterskin and a roll of prayers written on hide; her left hand bare, never gloved. She stands upright, a stubborn, questioning look.
private: Resting in the shrine: the short robe off, a long-sleeved dark wool dress to the shins and a knitted shawl, soft shoes, the teal hair loose. She sits holding the prayer roll open on her knees, the left palm turned up, a tired, thoughtful look.
battle: Behind the shield line: the iron-grey knee-short robe belted over a quilted vest with thin enchanted iron plates, leather bracers, the small round shield on the right arm with its carved prayer lit by a steady miracle light. The bare left palm is raised and glowing with pale light before her. Feet planted, a fierce, steady look.
formal: At the shrine's great service: a long iron-grey robe to the ankles with a narrow silver border, the small round shield on her back, hair neatly combed, the bare left palm open. She stands very straight, a grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the wine-red eyes looking straight at the viewer, not up, a stubborn, grave look. Pale silvery light rising from the raised left palm on one side, cool grey light on the other. Foreground blur: the glowing open palm. She wears the short iron-grey robe.

name: 马库斯
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:1075
who: Markus, a human tanner's youngest son who has joined the Shield-bearer's shrine as an acolyte, fourteen years old and looks it: thin, about 158 cm, shooting up so fast that his sleeves are always a bit short, wholly covered by his clothes. Untidy wheat-coloured hair, a freckled face, fingers stained yellow by tanning water, sky-blue eyes that look straight at people. A blunt, eager, forward-looking air; he never looks back. The tanning stain is only a faint yellow-brown tint on the fingers and fingertips, like old dye soaked into skin; the hands themselves are the same pale skin as his face, NOT solid yellow and NOT gloves.
palette: wheat and sky blue, acolyte iron-grey, tanner's yellow, plain wood
casual: His acolyte clothes: a short iron-grey acolyte's robe with the sleeves a little short, over trousers and boots; on his back a small bare wooden shield with no leather cover yet; at his belt a small skinning knife his father gave him. He stands with his chin up, an eager, open look.
private: At home in the tanners' lane: a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, a knitted vest and wool trousers, the sleeves rolled. He sits on a doorstep reciting half a prayer under his breath, a cheerful, stubborn look.
battle: Standing at Clara's side: the short acolyte's robe belted tight, the small bare wooden shield gripped in both hands before him. Braced with the feet together, the chin up, he carries no sword, an earnest, unafraid look, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the acolyte-post outfit: steady and earnest, the feet apart, the chin up, holding the small bare wooden shield out in front with both hands; he does not fight with a blade.
formal: At the shrine's great service: a clean long iron-grey acolyte's robe with a rope belt, the sleeves for once the right length, laced at the neck, a thin silver thread stitched along the hem. He holds the small wooden shield at his chest, a prayer line freshly carved across its face, his hair combed flat. He stands straight, a solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the sky-blue eyes open and looking straight at the viewer, an earnest, serious look, the mouth closed. Cold dawn light from one side. Foreground blur: the edge of a small wooden shield. He wears the short acolyte's robe.

name: 安东
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:1131
who: Anton Fallingleaf, a human shield-bearer from the lake country, twenty-two years old: about 174 cm, medium height with thick shoulders and short, steady legs from standing on boats, sunburnt at the neck. Short-cropped sea-blue hair, silver-grey eyes that narrow when a bell or horn sounds, an old scar across the web of the left hand (on the viewer's right when they face us) from a shield strap. A quiet, good-memoried, plain-spoken air; he stands in the front rank every day.
palette: sea blue and silver grey, lake-star white, worn leather brown, shield steel
casual: His wall clothes: a southern shield-bearer's leather jerkin with the lake-star crest nailed on the chest over a wool shirt, trousers and boots; a long oval shield on his arm, its face worn and with a deep axe-cut across the edge (picked up from the ground); his belt empty of any sword. He stands with a boatman's wide stance, a calm, steady look.
private: Resting by the barracks fire: the jerkin off, a long-sleeved wool shirt with the sleeves rolled and an old knitted vest, soft boots. He sits with the notched shield propped beside him, turning a mug in his hands, a quiet, absent look.
battle: In the front rank: the leather jerkin laced up with the lake-star crest nailed on the chest, a thin enchanted iron plate strapped over it, leather bracers and a plain iron cap. The long oval shield is planted in front with its edge on the ground and both hands braced behind it, ward lines carved along its rim giving a steady cool light. Feet wide, shoulders squared, a hard, steady look.
formal: On the day the names are read: a lake-grey garrison coat worn open over the leather jerkin, the collar folded down, the lake-star crest in pale iron nailed to the chest with a faint cool glow, a cord tied round his left wrist, a blue-green sash at the waist. The notched oval shield is grounded at his side. He stands very straight, a grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the silver-grey eyes looking straight at the viewer with a quiet, steady look, the mouth closed. Cold lake-blue light from one side. Foreground blur: the axe-cut edge of a worn shield. He wears the leather jerkin with the star crest.

name: 缇里安
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:1511
who: Tirian, an elf of the old forest's Watcher clan who has looked twenty-five for centuries, the Day-drawer bowman of the south wall: about 180 cm, slender and tall. Long pale gold hair nearly white, deep forest-green eyes, long pointed elf ears, a quiet, ageless face. His right arm hangs at his side and has not been lifted since the great shot, never hidden; he teaches with the left hand only. On his back an old longbow whose limb bears a deep grip-mark in the shape of a right hand. A short-worded, waiting air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a calm young-looking elf's face, deep forest-green eyes, long pointed ears, pale gold near-white hair, a still, closed mouth; he looks twenty-five.
build: 180 cm, slender and tall; the right arm hangs limp at his side (on the viewer's left when they face us) while the left arm is active and strong.
palette: pale gold and forest green, faded grey-green, bow-wood brown, antler ivory
casual: His teacher's clothes: a long hooded cloak of faded grey-green over a moss-green tunic, dark fitted leggings and soft boots, a leather bracer on the left arm; the old longbow slung across his back, the right arm hanging bare at his side. He stands a step behind where a pupil would be, a quiet, watching look.
private: Resting in the wall-side quarters: the cloak off, a loose long-sleeved pale linen tunic, soft leggings and slippers, the hair loose over the shoulders. He sits holding a cup in his left hand, the right arm resting in his lap, a still, faraway look.
battle: Waiting on the third level behind the wall: the grey-green cloak pinned back, the left bracer on, a quiver of grey-fletched arrows at the hip, the longbow held across his body in the left hand with an arrow resting and not drawn. A still, patient, piercing look.
formal: Before the elven high court: a long silvery-green robe embroidered at the hems with small leaves, a pale mantle over one shoulder, a thin circlet of woven twigs, the old longbow carried in the left hand. He stands tall and still, the right arm hanging, a calm look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the forest-green eyes looking past the viewer into the distance with an unhurried look, the face unchanged by centuries but the eyes carrying them. Cool forest light filtering through leaves from one side. Foreground blur: drifting leaves and the grip-marked bow limb. He wears the grey-green hooded cloak.

name: 莉尔缇
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:1527
who: Liltie, a wood-elf herbalist of the forest-village at the western edge of the sea of trees, a legend who has looked twenty-something for centuries: about 165 cm, slight and quiet. Pale gold hair in a braid wound with straw cord, moss-green eyes that look down at the ground, long pointed elf ears, hands always soiled with earth. Around her neck hangs one dried flower bud. She wraps herself in a single snow-fox pelt all year round, summer too. A slow, silent air that says one thing per sentence.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young-looking elf's face, soft, moss-green eyes looking downward, long pointed ears, pale gold hair, a small closed mouth, faint soil smudges on one cheek.
build: 165 cm, slight and light-boned, with narrow shoulders, a small bust and a slim waist.
palette: pale gold and moss green, snow-fox white and russet, dry-bud brown, earth umber
casual: Her herbalist's clothes: a whole snow-fox pelt draped round her shoulders and wrapped about her body, fur side out, over a moss-green wool dress to the shins with a belt of straw cord, soft boots; round her neck on a cord one dry flower bud; a small trowel and a bundle of herbs in a cloth bag at her side. She stands looking at the ground, a quiet look.
private: Resting by the garden: the pelt still round her shoulders, under it a loose long-sleeved undyed linen dress, soft shoes, the braid over one shoulder. She kneels at a patch of earth, pressing a seedling into it with both hands, a gentle, absorbed look.
battle: Walking into the poisoned mist: the snow-fox pelt wrapped tight and pinned, a hood of moss-green cloth over the hair, leather gloves, the herb bag on a strap across the chest; in one hand a small bunch of living green shoots held out in front of her. Eyes lowered, a still, resolved look, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the herbalist's outfit: calm and resolved, the feet together, the eyes lowered toward the ground, one hand holding a small bunch of green shoots out in front of her, the snow-fox pelt wrapped tight; she is not a fighter and carries no weapon.
formal: At the forest-village's spring rite: a long moss-green robe embroidered with fine vines at the hems and cuffs, the snow-fox pelt worn as a mantle, a wreath of fresh green shoots in her braid, the dried bud on its cord. She stands still with the hands folded, a calm look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the moss-green eyes lowered toward the viewer's hands, a quiet, still look, the face unchanged by centuries but the eyes carrying them. Pale cold light from one side, a faint green warmth from below. Foreground blur: a handful of damp soil with one tiny green sprout. She wears the snow-fox pelt.

name: 瑞恩·无名
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:1543
who: Ryan Nameless, a human former mine slave known only by his number, a legend who has looked thirty-one for centuries: about 178 cm, lean and tight-muscled with thick forearms and shoulders, skin pale as one who has not seen the sun and eyes that squint in daylight. On his left wrist hangs a coarse iron shackle, the lock open, never taken off. At his belt a small oil lamp whose oil is never allowed to run dry, and in his hand a worn miner's hammer with three notches knocked out of its head. A few words only, a heavy, sleepless air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, pale man in his early thirties with the eyes of someone who has watched too long, squinting a little, dark brows, a closed hard mouth; no beard.
build: 178 cm, lean and wiry with thick forearms, heavy shoulders and a mine-worker's tight frame.
palette: pale ash and soot black, iron grey, lamp-flame amber, dull rust
casual: His everyday clothes: a plain grey coarse-wool shirt with the sleeves rolled and a sleeveless leather jerkin, dark trousers and heavy boots; on the left wrist the coarse open iron shackle hanging with its chain trailing; at his belt a small oil lamp; a worn miner's hammer carried in the right hand. He stands with his shoulders low, a wary, squinting look.
private: Resting in the dark: the jerkin off, a long-sleeved grey wool shirt, the shackle still on the left wrist, boots off. He sits with his back to a wall and the small lit lamp on the floor beside him, a heavy, sleepless look.
battle: Holding the narrow wall alone: the leather jerkin laced tight, the open shackle swinging from the left wrist, the lamp hooked on his belt, the miner's hammer swung back in both hands. Feet planted wide, a fierce, silent look.
formal: At a hall he does not wish to enter: a clean dark-grey wool coat with a folded-down collar and no buttons at the neck, belted with plain rope, its seams stitched with copper thread that glows like banked coals. The same open shackle hangs from the left wrist and the small lamp is lit at his belt. The hammer is left leaning at his side. He stands very still, a heavy, blank look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the eyes narrowed against the light, looking at the viewer with a heavy, silent look, the face unchanged by centuries but the eyes carrying them. Warm lamp-flame light from the side below, cold dark behind. Foreground blur: the open iron shackle chain and the small lit lamp. He wears the grey wool shirt and leather jerkin.

name: 古尔巴
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:1558
who: Gulba, a half-orc from the southern river valleys, a legend who has looked twenty-nine for centuries: about 205 cm, tall and very broad, a mountain of a man. Grey-green skin, two tusk tips just showing past the lower lip, slow amber eyes that take a long look at people. In his hand a stone staff taller than himself with a permanent curve pressed into its middle that will not straighten. At his belt a straw pouch holding small straw goats he weaves for children. One word at a time, heavy and kind. The stone staff is a plain rough pole of grey stone, taller than he is, with both ends straight and blunt; its only feature is one smooth bow-like bend at the middle of its length, as if a great weight had pressed it, and it is drawn the same way in every panel, with no hook or crook at the top.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, calm grey-green face of a man in his late twenties, slow amber eyes, two small tusk tips just showing, a heavy brow, a gentle closed mouth.
build: 205 cm, very tall and broad, huge shoulders and thick arms, a heavy, steady stance.
palette: grey-green and stone grey, amber, straw yellow, dull earth brown
casual: His everyday clothes: a sleeveless heavy leather jerkin over a rough undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, wide trousers and heavy boots; a straw pouch at his belt with small woven straw goats poking out; in his right hand a stone staff taller than he is, bent in the middle. He stands with his shoulders slightly down, a slow, patient look.
private: Resting outside a hut: the jerkin off, a loose long-sleeved linen shirt, wide trousers, bare feet. He sits on a boulder weaving a small straw goat in his big fingers, the staff leaning at his side, a gentle, absorbed look.
battle: Bracing under the collapse: the leather jerkin laced tight, leather bracers, the stone staff planted upright in front of him with both hands gripping it, the shoulders hunched as if holding up the ceiling. Feet planted, a steady, heavy look.
formal: At a valley gathering: a long undyed wool coat with a woven straw sash, the straw pouch at his belt, the stone staff held upright in his right hand. He stands very still, a calm, kind look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the slow amber eyes looking straight at the viewer with a gentle, patient look, the face unchanged by centuries but the eyes carrying them. Warm earth-yellow light from one side. Foreground blur: a small woven straw goat held toward the viewer. He wears the leather jerkin.
art_extra: Even in warm light his skin stays plainly grey-green, the colour of lichen on stone, never brown, tan or olive.

name: 托卡
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:1574
who: Toka, a beast-eared hunter of the Windbell highlands, a legend who has looked thirty for centuries: about 178 cm, long-legged with narrow shoulders. Short silver-grey hair, a pair of grey beast ears with black-tipped points, pale gold eyes; his shoulders still flinch first at thunder. A rope with no splice in it is coiled round his waist, and touching it numbs the fingers. A brooding, short-worded air that names the weather first.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, sombre man's face in his thirties, pale gold eyes, grey beast ears with black tips on top of the head (and NO human ears at the sides), a closed mouth.
build: 178 cm, long-legged with narrow shoulders and a lean, wiry frame.
palette: silver grey and pale gold, black ear-tips, storm slate, hemp rope straw
casual: His highland hunter's clothes: a rough grey wool tunic and a sleeveless leather vest, loose trousers tucked into wrapped boots, a hooded storm-grey cloak; a long unspliced hemp rope wound several times around his waist. He stands looking at the sky first, a brooding look.
private: Resting on the high crag beside the great beast's sleeping place: the cloak off, a long-sleeved undyed wool tunic, the rope still on his waist, boots off. He sits with his knees drawn up, looking out at the clouds, a quiet, distant look.
battle: Riding into the storm: the leather vest laced tight, the cloak whipping back, leather bracers; the long hemp rope off the waist and gripped in both hands as reins, held taut before him. Crouched forward, a determined, fearful-but-forward look, no sword and no bow.
formal: At a highland gathering: a long storm-grey coat with a plain hemp sash, the rope coiled and hung at his belt, the cloak pinned at one shoulder. He stands with the hands at his sides, a quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the pale gold eyes looking up and away at a storm sky, a brooding, distant look, the face unchanged by centuries but the eyes carrying them. Cold storm-grey light from above, with a faint blue-white flicker at one side. Foreground blur: the coil of hemp rope and a few raindrops. He wears the leather vest and storm-grey cloak.

name: 法隆
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:1592
who: Faron, a winged demon archer of the southern enemy camps who has looked about thirty since the year his name was made: about 182 cm, thin and light-boned. A pair of black wings on his back that fold down to his heels, no horns visible (the wings alone mark him), steel-grey hair tied back, dull-gold eyes that see far in the dark. On his back an old longbow whose limbs are lined with a thin layer of scale pressed flat, water-coloured against the light. Almost silent, replying to others with a single word: speak.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, pale grey-skinned man in his early thirties, dull-gold eyes watching far, steel-grey hair, a long, quiet face, a closed mouth; no horns. In the expression grid each face sits on a fully transparent background with crisp cut edges, with no mist, smoke, fog, glow or haze painted around the figure.
build: 182 cm, thin and light-boned, long-limbed, with a narrow back that carries the folded wings.
palette: steel grey and dull gold, wing black, bow-scale water-blue, worn dark leather
casual: His archer's clothes: a close-fitting dark-grey leather jerkin cut open down the back for the folded black wings, a long-sleeved wool shirt, dark trousers and soft boots; a leather bracer on the left arm; the long scale-lined bow slung across his back, a quiver at his hip. He stands with his wings folded down to his heels, a still, watchful look.
private: Resting at the edge of a pine wood: the jerkin off, a loose long-sleeved dark linen shirt cut for the wings, soft boots. He sits with the bow across his knees, running a thumb along its scale-lined limb, a quiet, far-off look.
battle: On a ridge at night: the dark leather jerkin laced up, the bracer on, the black wings half open and low. He draws the long scale-lined bow to full, the arrow aimed at something unseen far away, feet planted, a cold, absolutely still look.
formal: In the camp's war council: a long dark-grey officer's coat open at the back for the wings, cut with a draped lapel, a silver chain across the chest and a plain silver clasp at one shoulder, grey feathers edging the cuffs, a scale-pattern leather bracer on the left arm. He holds the bow unstrung in the left hand, a thin silver rune line along its limb. He stands very still, the wings folded, a grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly aside, the dull-gold eyes looking straight at the viewer, a quiet, unfathomable look, the face unchanged by years but the eyes carrying them; one folded black wing visible behind his shoulder. Low cold starlight from one side. Foreground blur: the water-coloured scale lining of the bow limb. He wears the dark leather jerkin.
